create_deepseek_vl_hybrid_model: create a DeepseekVLHybridModel instance for multimodal vision-language processing with low and high resolution image encodings
build_conditional_generation_model: build a DeepseekVLHybridForConditionalGeneration model for autoregressive text generation conditioned on image and text inputs
run_forward_pass_multimodal: run a forward pass through the DeepseekVLHybridModel with image pixel values and text input ids to produce hidden states
generate_text_conditioned_on_images: generate text autoregressively from a DeepseekVLHybridForConditionalGeneration model conditioned on image pixel values and input ids
test_aligner_fusion: test the DeepseekVLHybridAligner that fuses low resolution and high resolution vision encodings into a unified representation
